sourceArchitecture.rule: Files are organized by atomic layer first and component family second.

documentationArchitecture.rule: The components documentation is organized by developer workflow first, then by atomic layer inside each family.

layers.title: Atoms
layers.definition: Smallest reusable UI components with finite props, states and token-backed styling.

layers.title: Molecules
layers.definition: Small reusable compositions of atoms or compact UI patterns that are not tied to one full page region.

layers.title: Organisms
layers.definition: Larger interface blocks that coordinate multiple atoms, molecules, states or page areas.

layers.title: Templates
layers.definition: Reusable starter compositions intended to be copied, adapted or used as page or interaction starters.

families.title: Text

families.title: Data Display

families.title: Media
families.description: Images, portraits, media wrappers and media composition patterns.

families.title: Visual

families.title: Disclosure

standalonePolicy.rule: Do not use global, shared or common as a catch-all family. A standalone component may be documented as its own one-component family.

componentRecordShape.name: Component filename without extension.
componentRecordShape.astroComponent: Astro component export/name used in documentation and ComponentInfoLayer.
componentRecordShape.layer: atom | molecule | organism | template | documentation | development
componentRecordShape.family: Approved family id or deliberate standalone family id.
componentRecordShape.sourcePath: Real Astro or framework-island component path.
componentRecordShape.docsAnchor: Real anchor in the design-system documentation.
componentRecordShape.agenticRule: Per-component rule file when it exists.
componentRecordShape.variants: Named variants when one source component exposes multiple documented variants.
componentRecordShape.attributes: Public data attributes used by the component.
componentRecordShape.props: Public Astro props exposed by the component.
componentRecordShape.states: Interactive states supported or documented by the component.
componentRecordShape.tokens: Component token contracts used by the component.
componentRecordShape.readiness: Current project visual adaptation and validation status; no history.

rules: Atomic layer decides the source folder.
Family decides the subfolder and documentation grouping.
Documentation is family-first for developer workflow.
The same family may exist under atoms, molecules and organisms.
Do not create empty source folders before real components exist.
Do not create top-level domain folders beside atoms, molecules and organisms.
Do not use global, shared, common or misc as component families.
Create or update per-component agentic rules when component UX role, variants, accessibility or implementation contract changes.
Update agentic rules, component registry and documentation together when the component architecture changes.

readinessModel.rule: Readiness records only current state. Git owns history.
